description:
Look up a US public company in SEC EDGAR by ticker or CIK: legal name, exchange, industry, state, fiscal year end, and its latest filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, insider Form 4 and more) with direct links. Filter by form type, e.g. only 10-Ks.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You need who a US public company is, or links to its recent filings.
Use instead: sec_financials for the numbers; company_snapshot for profile plus numbers; company_due_diligence for ratios and 8-K summaries.
Parameters: ticker or cik (one is required). form: only this form type, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 4. limit: 1-40 filings, default 10.
Returns: name, CIK, exchange, industry, state, fiscal year end, and filings[] with form, date and link.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193. Give this or ticker.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. "AAPL". Give this or cik.

name: sec_company
title: SEC company profile and filings
